messages:
Olivia (support): heads up — multiple customers (starting with acme-inc) seeing 502/504s against Hosted API in us-west-2 since ~09:12 PDT. Affects both streaming completions and normal requests. curl produces \u003c HTTP/2 502 \u003e and an upstream reset. trace_id=tr-0a1b2c3d

Ben (eng-sre): any deploys in last hour? can you paste the gateway/envoy logs + a sample request id?

Olivia (support): deploy-bot shows no deploys since 08:40. sample client trace and curl output attached below. customer says error happens when they send large embedding batch and when they open a long streaming session.

Olivia (support): ```
$ curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hosted/completions\" -d '{"model":"rwd-xl","input":"...","stream":true}'
* Rebuilt URL to: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hosted/completions
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (35.201.xx.xx) port 443 (#0)
* HTTP/2 stream 0 was closed, errno = 0
* Connection reset by peer
* Closing connection 0
< HTTP/2 502
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream reset", "trace":"tr-0a1b2c3d"}
```

Olivia (support): gateway logs (snip):
```
[2026-03-18T16:12:18Z] envoy [warning] upstream reset: stream reset, error=INTERNAL_ERROR, upstream_host=10.3.45.12:443, bytes_received=0, trace=tr-0a1b2c3d
[2026-03-18T16:12:18Z] envoy [info] connpool: active_streams=120, conn_pool_size=8, idle_connections=0
[2026-03-18T16:12:19Z] nginx [error] 502 while reading response header from upstream
```

Kevin (frontend): i'm also seeing auth-cache miss bursts right before each spike — header `x-tenant-id` shows fanout to 6 upstreams. Hit rate drops from ~98% to ~35% for a few seconds, then 502s start. Could be connpool starvation + long-lived streaming requests holding H2 streams.

maria (oncall): agree this smells like connection window / pool exhaustion. Any large batching or embeddings churn today? ingest-bot, any spike?

ingest-bot: [metric] embeddings-batcher queue depth jumped 5x at 16:11:30 UTC, average open streams per worker increased from 2 -> 18 for a short window.

Ben (eng-sre): ok that correlates. Likely pattern: big tenant starts many concurrent streaming/embedding requests (long tail), ties up H2 streams on midproxy/upstream, auth cache misses fanout requests -> auth backend slow -> more fanout -> connpool exhausted -> envoy resets/502s. Quick mitigations: 1) limit per-tenant concurrent streams at edge; 2) increase conn_pool_size or allow burst capacity; 3) enable prefix/KV caching for auth tokens to reduce fanout.

Olivia (support): can we do a hotfix for acme-inc while we dig? they are blocked in prod.

Ben (eng-sre): I'll push a temporary per-tenant rate-limit rule on frontdoor for tenant acme-inc to 50 rps and reduce max_concurrent_streams to 6. Doing now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by Ben -> route-configs/2026-03-18/tenant-rate-limits (diff +3 lines).

Olivia (support): applied; customer confirms errors dropped within 20s and resumed normal traffic. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): longer-term follow-ups: - investigate auth-cache TTL/eviction causing fanout spikes - add H2 stream/connmetrics alert earlier (threshold lower) - consider per-tenant circuit-breaker for auth backend - analyze embeddings batcher for burst shaping

Ben (eng-sre): created follow-up ticket INF-9482 with logs and recommended fixes. I'll schedule a runbook step to prefer fallback model/midproxy when connpool hits threshold.

Kevin (frontend): note for product: recommend adding client-side guidance to chunk large embedding requests and exponential backoff for streaming reconnects.

Olivia (support): i'll update the customer and include repro steps we used + temporary mitigation. marking this thread resolved unless anything else crops up.

Ben (eng-sre): leaving notes in incident channel and linking INF-9482. thanks team.
